notes.title: The Future of Bliss Valley (And more) - Developer Update - 9/10/2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're finally upon the half-year anniversary of Bliss Valley, and I just have to say that the fact we're still getting so much positive feedback from you guys is amazing. We're thrilled that you enjoyed the 1.2 update just as much as we had fun making it! Bliss Valley 1.2 was meant to be a final hurrah for the game while we worked on our next project... Or should I say projects.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The New Game[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]During our dev update on June, 25th of this year we talked about a new project in the works that we were excited for but ultimately was going to be 100% SFW. The project is still in full swing, but the scope of the project is getting bigger week by week. We wanna ensure a quality product, so we're taking our time with this one. What we have so far looks awesome, and we're super excited for you all to see it!
[/p][p][b]"Awe, so I have to wait a while for a new game?"[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]hehehehe... remember? I said project(s).[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The Other Game[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Yup! In addition to the big long term project we're toiling away at, we have another game in the works... And OH BOY! You're gonna like this one. We didn't wanna alienate those of you who fell in love with Bliss Valley with another project that was wildly different. So, we decided it would be best that we would begin work on a game that's familiar to what we established in Bliss Valley. 

[b]"Neato, so the same formula as Bliss Valley?"[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Not quite! We don't wanna rest on a laurels and push out a game that's pretty much Bliss Valley 1 with a new cast. We wanna go bigger! This new game will feature a MUCH larger cast of characters to interact with and locations to explore. We're moving away from the traditional visual novel format and moving into something much more engaging. Dialogue trees, RPG elements, more characters, more locations, choices that matter, non-linearity, etc. [/p][p][/p][p][b]"Wait... Did you just say Bliss Valley 1?"[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Oops.

[/i][u][b]What's the new game?[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p][i]Same town! New vibe![/i][/p][p][/p][p]You got to see one side of Bliss Valley last time, now it's time to see it's nightlife. 

[/p][p]This new venture into the city of Bliss Valley will showcase a whole new, never-before seen side of the town. It'll follow a similar formula to the previous game, but MUCH more open! [/p][p]Enjoy a fun night at the bar with a cute raver bunny girl or get involved in a (sexy?) turf war. The choice is yours![/p][p][b]"When can I expect to hear more about this game?"[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Very very soon! There's a lot we've been working on and we can't wait to show you all! This game is 10 times more ambitious than the original Bliss Valley.  Don't worry! We'll keep you posted.[/p][p][/p][p][i]It's gonna be AMAZING!

[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503449/8b296aeb4e246018ca30f789635c40f18201c65f.png"][/img][/p][p]
Thanks so much everyone for sticking with us everyone! Things are looking exciting for the future and we can't wait for you to see what we have in store! 

Much love <3 

- The Amusement Studios Team 
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bliss Valley - Developer Update - 6/5/2025
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone! [/b]

It's been a while since we talked, but that's because we've had our heads down working on our next project!

Next project, you say? Indeed! While we can't say much now... We will say we've been working on a new game that we're very excited about! The project overall is much more ambitious than Bliss Valley, yet still familiar to the style we've established. The new game (and I hope this doesn't disappoint you all) will be 100% SFW, minus some moments of strong language. 

[b]"That's fine and dandy you gorgeous developer, but what about Bliss Valley?"[/b]

Don't worry! We haven't forgotten about our first project!

In fact... big things are in store for Bliss Valley! 

[u][b]What's new with Bliss Valley? [/b]
[/u]

First off, We'd like to say that the support we've gotten for Bliss Valley is incredible. We're blown away by how many of you really enjoyed your time with the game. For this reason, we've delved back into the world of Bliss Valley to create a final update for the game. The update will focus on adding brand new content, scenes, character sprites, locations, and more!

[i]-Mox [/i]

[i]in this patch, thanks to a player review, we've also fixed a few accidental misgendering issues. This arose because as we were developing the game, the identities of the characters weren't entirely set in stone. I should have caught that, but I must have missed it while I was proofreading. Whoops! Sorry, Robin. 

As another proofreading failure, I also missed a few grammar mistakes. Should be all better now. I choose to blame it on my poor eyesight.[/i]

[i]-Aloe[/i]

[u][b]The New Location [/b][/u]

The new location is set within the mall. On each of the characters mall date, you will now also be heading to [b]The Clarkade[/b]! The Clarkade will host quite a few things to do and will be much more involved compared to the date scenes that you've become accustomed to.

In The Clarkade, you will be granted 30 tokens to start off with. How you use these tokens will determine how your date feels.

Spend all your tokens on one mini game? Well... that might bode well for how your date will feel about it. 

The tokens will be your ticket to playing mini games, going to a funhouse, and getting ice cream at the ice cream parlor.

While we don't have a lot to show right now... Trust us, they're pretty cool.

[u][b]New Scenes![/b][/u]

In addition to The Clarkade... we're buffing up the game with new scenes peppered out through the main campaign. Here's an example of Robin singing their heart out. :3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503449/702d36d7a72e2a54f8e83d9363f917929e49b9ac.png[/img]

Robin, Bella and Ellie will all be getting more dialogue and new scenes.

[u][b]Character Sprites[/b][/u]

The trio of characters are all getting an upgrade!

Each character will be getting a handful of new sprites. Including; new expressions, new poses, and 




Okay... fine. We'll show you some concept art.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503449/f4d7e2f40c76a5c577bc7a6f03533941633baaf9.png[/img]


Aww... Aren't they adorable?


[b]"Character shmaracter... I WANNA GOON!"[/b]

Well don't you worry! We've got stuff for you too!

The trio of characters will also be receiving new NSFW sprites, and the nsfw scenes are being extended as well.

Happy gooning! :^)


[b]"THIS IS AMAZING!!! I WANNA GIVE YOU MORE MONEY!!!!!"[/b]

Awe, really? Alright fine... But it'll have to be the game's soundtrack. Sorry I don't make the rules, I just think them up and write them down.

[u][b]SOUNDTRACK FOR SALE[/b][/u]

Here in the near future, the soundtrack for Bliss Valley will be available to purchase! 

[b]"Can't I just go into the game's files and listen to them from there?"[/b]

Shhhhh....

[i]-Mox [/i]

[i]Wow, the amount of positive feedback we've been getting is insane! I can't thank everyone enough for the consistent kindness and love I've received in regards to my art. 
Publishing the game felt like a risk, as I know my art is somewhat niche. I'm an impressionist and a surrealist through-and-through, and it's difficult to break away from that style. I found myself unsatisfied with backgrounds that I tried to polish into a more "mainstream" style; I'm also not nearly as experienced with backgrounds as I am with character design, so I was very afraid it would be a sticking point for a lot of our audience. However, it seems like you guys really love it! It's been a major confidence boost to my art, and has left me excited to go into our next project. 

The new game has been an interesting development experience. It's a lot more ambitious than Bliss Valley. Thanks to a lot of feedback we've gotten, we've made the decision to make the game SFW, and to focus more on adding more depth to a wider variety of characters. It's still written for an adult audience, but there won't be any nudity or sex scenes. People seemed to really enjoy our creative writing and the silly atmosphere, so we'll be giving more of that. I'm very excited to show you what we have in store!

-Aloe[/i]


Well... that about covers everything.

We'll have a release date for the soundtrack and the new update soon!

I don't know how to end these.

Bye.

[i]-Mox [/i]

notes.title: Bliss Valley 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503449/482495f20baab411903cef0def1c4209bca6aca7.png[/img]

[b]Bliss Valley[/b] gets it's very first major update!


Hello all you beautiful people! We're pleased to release Bliss Valley's first major update! 


What can you expect from update 1.1? We're glad you asked!

[u]
[b]New achievements!
[/b][/u]

We've added a grand total of 7 new achievements for you to collect! 4 of those achievements are hidden, which should encourage replayability! Keep your eyes peeled!

[u][b]Safe For Work Mode![/b][/u]

We've gotten many kind comments from a lot of you on how you enjoyed Bliss Valley's story and script. We've realized that the NSFW nature of Bliss Valley may be a turn off to a lot of people. Due to this, we've decided to implement a safe for work mode that can be toggled on and off at the start of a new playthrough! Scenes involving NSFW content are not displayed in SFW mode, and the scenes have been rewritten accordingly. 

[u][b]Various Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

Whoops! Seems we left a few bugs in the game. Don't worry though, we're on the case! We've removed several bugs that may have been hampering your anthro adventure!

[u][b]More Details [/b][/u]

[u]Changes[/u]

[b]Change:[/b] Nudity and erotic animations in the gallery have been labeled NSFW.
[b]Change:[/b] Sex scenes in the epilogues haven been labeled NSFW and made optional.
[b]Change:[/b] Added a SFW mode that is toggled at the start of a new playthrough.
[b]Change:[/b] Rewrote scenes/Removed NSFW Visuals for SFW Mode.
[b]Change:[/b] Added 7 New achievements (4 of which are hidden.) The game now offers 15 achievements.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
-Fixed an issue causing an ending not to play 
-Fixed an issue with Bella's clothes remaining after her sprite has left
-Fixed an issue causing bella to talk during robin's path 
-Fixed an issue causing a background to stutter 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503449/5a65a8f0ffce57162832ae075415e891e09b7a91.png[/img]


[b]QUESTION: Will Bliss Valley get any DLC?[/b]

ANSWER: Maybe! It all depends if the demand is there for it! We'd love to continue expanding the world of Bliss Valley.


[b]QUESTION: Will this DLC be free?[/b]

ANSWER: Unfortunately we don't have an answer for this. That will change if we decide to start working on DLC for the game!


[b]QUESTION: What does the future hold for Bliss Valley?[/b]

ANSWER: We have a few ideas for how we can improve the game further; New scenes, more dialogue, more endings, etc. If a community begins to grow around Bliss Valley, we'll definitely consider all of these!


[b]QUESTION: What did you use to make Bliss Valley?[/b]

ANSWER: We used RenPy!


[b]QUESTION: What is the identity of the protagonist?[/b]

ANSWER: We've left the identity of the protagonist ambiguous so that player can better project themselves into the world of Bliss Valley.


[b]QUESTION: How can I support Bliss Valley/Amusement Studios?[/b]

ANSWER: If you already own a copy of Bliss Valley, the best way to support is to leave a review.


[b]QUESTION: I found a bug in Bliss Valley, what should I do?[/b]

ANSWER: Yikes! If you found a bug in Bliss Valley, the best thing you can do is contact us!


[b]QUESTION: How can I contact Amusement Studios?[/b]

ANSWER: You can contact us via our bluesky: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/amusementstudios.bsky.social]Amusement Studios' Bluesky[/url]

Alternatively, you can contact us at: contact@amusementstudiosgame.com


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Well that's everything! Thanks everyone for your support! See ya next update!
